description: For every axiom-certificate relation \(E\), if \(p,q\) certify sentences with codes \(a\to b\) and \(a\), respectively, and \(b\) is a sentence code, then the specified record \(M(p,q,b)\) is an accepted certificate for \(b\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.modusPonensCertificate_accepted.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) (E : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (p q a b : ℕ)
  (hp :
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck S E p
        (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.impCode a b) =
      true)
  (hq : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck S E q a = true)
  (hb : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.isSentence S b = true) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck S E
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.modusPonensCertificate p q b) b =
    true
